queries.env: select current_user as connector_role, current_setting('server_version') as server_version, pg_database_size(current_database()) as database_bytes, current_timestamp as observed_at;
queries.functions: select n.nspname as schema,p.proname,pg_get_function_identity_arguments(p.oid) as arguments,p.prosecdef as security_definer,p.proconfig,p.proacl::text as acl,md5(pg_get_functiondef(p.oid)) as definition_md5,pg_get_functiondef(p.oid) as definition from pg_proc p join pg_namespace n on n.oid=p.pronamespace where n.nspname in ('public','private') and p.proname in ('admin_set_member_status','admin_set_member_role','system_admin_set_permissions','admin_approve_join_request','admin_review_join_request','protect_profile_privileged_columns','is_approved_member','is_admin','is_system_admin','has_admin_permission','bootstrap_system_admin') order by n.nspname,p.proname;
queries.boundary: select c.relname,c.relrowsecurity,c.relforcerowsecurity,c.relacl::text as acl from pg_class c join pg_namespace n on n.oid=c.relnamespace where n.nspname='public' and c.relname in ('profiles','admin_permissions','join_requests') order by c.relname;
queries.triggers: select n.nspname as schema,c.relname,t.tgname,pg_get_triggerdef(t.oid) as definition from pg_trigger t join pg_class c on c.oid=t.tgrelid join pg_namespace n on n.oid=c.relnamespace where not t.tgisinternal and ((n.nspname='public' and c.relname in ('profiles','admin_permissions','join_requests')) or (n.nspname='auth' and c.relname in ('sessions','users'))) order by n.nspname,c.relname,t.tgname;
queries.policies: select schemaname,tablename,policyname,roles,cmd,qual,with_check from pg_policies where schemaname='public' and tablename in ('profiles','admin_permissions','join_requests') order by tablename,policyname;
queries.auth_metadata: select c.relname,c.relacl::text as acl,c.relrowsecurity,c.relforcerowsecurity,has_table_privilege(current_user,c.oid,'SELECT') as connector_can_select from pg_class c join pg_namespace n on n.oid=c.relnamespace where n.nspname='auth' and c.relname in ('users','sessions');
queries.writers: select n.nspname as schema,p.proname,pg_get_function_identity_arguments(p.oid) as arguments,md5(pg_get_functiondef(p.oid)) as definition_md5,pg_get_functiondef(p.oid) as definition from pg_proc p join pg_namespace n on n.oid=p.pronamespace where n.nspname in ('public','private') and p.prokind='f' and (p.prosrc ~* '(update[[:space:]]+(public[.])?profiles|delete[[:space:]]+from[[:space:]]+(public[.])?profiles|insert[[:space:]]+into[[:space:]]+(public[.])?admin_permissions|delete[[:space:]]+from[[:space:]]+(public[.])?admin_permissions)' ) order by n.nspname,p.proname;
queries.auth_schema: select table_schema,table_name,column_name,data_type from information_schema.columns where table_schema='auth' and table_name='sessions' order by ordinal_position;
queries.foreignkeys: select n.nspname as schema,c.relname,con.conname,pg_get_constraintdef(con.oid) as definition from pg_constraint con join pg_class c on c.oid=con.conrelid join pg_namespace n on n.oid=c.relnamespace where con.contype='f' and n.nspname='public' and c.relname in ('profiles','admin_permissions','join_requests') order by c.relname,con.conname;
queries.auth_roles: select r as role_name,has_table_privilege(r,'auth.sessions','SELECT') as can_select_sessions,has_table_privilege(r,'auth.users','SELECT') as can_select_users from unnest(array['anon','authenticated','service_role','postgres']) r;

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.has_admin_permission(p_permission text)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
  select private.is_system_admin() or (
    p_permission in ('members', 'community', 'games', 'content', 'operations') and exists (
      select 1 from public.profiles p
      join public.admin_permissions ap on ap.user_id = p.id
      where p.id = (select auth.uid()) and p.role = 'admin' and p.status = 'approved'
        and ap.permission = p_permission
    )
  );
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.is_admin()
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
  select private.is_system_admin();
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.is_approved_member()
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
    select exists (
        select 1
        from public.profiles as p
        where p.id = (select auth.uid())
          and p.status = 'approved'
    );
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.is_system_admin()
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
  select exists (
    select 1 from public.profiles p
    where p.id = (select auth.uid()) and p.role = 'system_admin' and p.status = 'approved'
  );
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.protect_profile_privileged_columns()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
begin
  if auth.uid() is not null and not private.is_system_admin() then
    if new.role is distinct from old.role
       or new.status is distinct from old.status
       or new.approved_at is distinct from old.approved_at
       or new.approved_by is distinct from old.approved_by
       or new.created_at is distinct from old.created_at
    then
      if not private.has_admin_permission('members')
         or coalesce(current_setting('app.allow_member_admin_update', true), 'false') <> 'true'
      then
        raise exception '권한 또는 승인 상태 컬럼은 변경할 수 없습니다.' using errcode = '42501';
      end if;
    end if;
  end if;
  return new;
end; $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.is_admin()
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
  select exists (
    select 1
    from public.admin_users
    where user_id = auth.uid()
  );
$function$
